summary: Tested the backend enquiry API (10/10 pytest pass: validation 422s plus a unit test of the rate limiter) and the frontend at 1920px and 390px. All 8 sections render in order. Nav links, the hero View-work button and the mobile menu all work. Exactly ONE real enquiry was submitted through the mobile form (name 'QA Test', brand 'QA Test Brand'): API returned 200 with email_id 01a17e9a-aa4d-7151-b5d9-3ca24fab325e, enquiry-success appeared, and Send another reset the form. One real responsive bug: on 390px the About section content is wider than the screen (434px vs 390px), so the about copy and polaroid are cut off on the right.

minor.issue: The rate-limit IP is read from the first X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. Anyone can bypass the 5-per-10-min limit by sending a fake XFF header, which allows spamming the creator's real inbox. Use the last proxy-appended hop or request.client.host behind a trusted proxy.

The rate limit is only checked after Pydantic validation, so a live 429 can only be triggered with 5 valid requests (5 real emails). It was verified with a unit test of _rate_limited instead (5 allowed, 6th blocked). The limiter also keeps recording hits after blocking, so the window keeps extending. The _recent dict is in-memory and never pruned (it grows without limit and resets on restart).
The DB insert happens before the email is sent. If sending fails (502/503) the user sees an error and may resubmit, which creates duplicate DB records.

ui_bugs.issue: Content overflows: grid items are 434px wide in a 390px viewport. About copy text and the polaroid are cut off on the right. Likely cause: the grid has no explicit column below lg, so its implicit auto track grows to the min-content width of the non-wrapping tags row (letter-spaced labels with divide-x). Suggested fix: add 'grid-cols-1' (or min-w-0 on the children) to the grid at About.jsx line 35, and 'flex-wrap' on the tags row at line 50.

issues: A placeholder/fake phone number '+91 98765 43210' is shown publicly. Replace it with the real number or remove it.
The logo text reads 'SONALI' and the polaroid note says 'I'm Sonali', but everywhere else (headline, footer ©) uses 'Sonalii'. Confirm the spelling is intentional.
The 'Portrait · Campaign' tile reuses the hero oval photo and is shorter than the other tiles, so the grid looks uneven. The remaining tiles are 'coming soon' placeholders (expected).

action_items: Fix the mobile overflow in the About section (About.jsx: add grid-cols-1 / min-w-0, and flex-wrap on the tags row)
Harden the rate-limit IP source (don't trust the first X-Forwarded-For value) and prune the _recent dict
Replace or remove the placeholder phone number +91 98765 43210 in Hire Me
